findings.reason: the record source has to be named correctly (registered worktrees matched to ledger run records by node id, as `_held_worktree_records` does), or the section sends an implementer to a pointer store that is empty in exactly the case the section exists to fix.
findings.text: s9 says the merge "releases every live pointer whose worktree HEAD is that head", but promotion unlinks the live pointer (`reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:190-191`, and the docstring of `_land_a_promoted_run` at `reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3285` states the pointer is deleted at promotion), so after the `crew complete` promotion of the section's own cited run no live pointer exists to enumerate; the retained record is the ledger row, which carries no `worktree` field (`reckon/ledger.py:150-200`) and from which a held tree is derived only by intersecting git's worktree registry with ledger namings (`reckon/crew/obligations.py:1862-1968`). A node implementing the deliverable as written releases nothing and its first case cannot pass
